description: Westland Wasp shipborne helicopter, SA Navy serial 85, taken on charge 25 May 1964 and donated to the SA Naval Museum in 2003 by the SAAF Museum at Ysterplaat. A defenceWeb article of 6 April 2023 marking the museum's 30th anniversary describes a Westland Wasp on display as a recent addition to the exhibit, which is good current corroboration. The type's primary shipborne role was anti-submarine; role_type utility chosen as the closest fit in the permitted vocabulary. Museum is free and open daily 09:30-15:30.
